# Signal Pilot Docs

> Official documentation for Signal Pilot's 7 non-repainting TradingView indicators. All v1.0. Platform: TradingView (Pine Script v6). Last updated: 2026-02-14.

Signal Pilot is a suite of professional TradingView indicators for technical analysis. All indicators are guaranteed non-repainting (close-confirmed signals only). The documentation covers setup, configuration, alert creation, webhook integrations, and a 4-phase trading workflow (Bias, Timing, Execution, Management).

## Indicators (all v1.0)

| Indicator | Version | Category | Doc URL |
|-----------|---------|----------|---------|
| Pentarch | v1.0 | Cycle detection | https://docs.signalpilot.io/pentarch-v10/ |
| OmniDeck | v1.0 | All-in-one overlay | https://docs.signalpilot.io/omnideck-v10/ |
| Janus Atlas | v1.0 | Auto-levels | https://docs.signalpilot.io/janus-atlas-v10/ |
| Augury Grid | v1.0 | Multi-TF screener | https://docs.signalpilot.io/augury-grid-v10/ |
| Plutus Flow | v1.0 | OBV analysis | https://docs.signalpilot.io/plutus-flow-v10/ |
| Harmonic Oscillator | v1.0 | Momentum consensus | https://docs.signalpilot.io/harmonic-oscillator-v10/ |
| Volume Oracle | v1.0 | Volume intelligence | https://docs.signalpilot.io/volume-oracle-v10/ |

## Indicator Guides (v1.0)

- [Pentarch v1.0](https://docs.signalpilot.io/pentarch-v10/): 5-cycle exhaustion and reversal detection — TD, IGN, WRN, CAP, BDN events across accumulation, markup, distribution, climax, and decline phases
- [Pentarch Learning Guide](https://docs.signalpilot.io/pentarch-v10/learning.html): Advanced Pentarch strategies, decision trees, and emotional recovery protocols
- [OmniDeck v1.0](https://docs.signalpilot.io/omnideck-v10/): All-in-one indicator with 10 systems: Exhaustion Counter, Squeeze, SuperTrend, Levels, Divergence, Momentum, Volume, Regime Detection, Signals, Alerts
- [OmniDeck Learning Guide](https://docs.signalpilot.io/omnideck-v10/learning.html): Multi-system trading psychology and decision trees
- [Janus Atlas v1.0](https://docs.signalpilot.io/janus-atlas-v10/): 60+ level types including VWAP, Fibonacci, Anchored VWAP, session levels, and market structure
- [Janus Atlas Learning Guide](https://docs.signalpilot.io/janus-atlas-v10/learning.html): Level trading psychology and support/resistance strategies
- [Augury Grid v1.0](https://docs.signalpilot.io/augury-grid-v10/): Multi-timeframe screener — 7 symbols × 3 timeframes with quality scoring and confluence detection
- [Augury Grid Learning Guide](https://docs.signalpilot.io/augury-grid-v10/learning.html): Multi-asset scanning and portfolio psychology
- [Augury Grid Timeframe Configuration](https://docs.signalpilot.io/augury-grid-v10/timeframe-configuration.html): Detailed timeframe setup — chart TF must equal or be lower than lowest scanner TF
- [Plutus Flow v1.0](https://docs.signalpilot.io/plutus-flow-v10/): Enhanced OBV with divergence detection, trend ribbons, and smart volume analysis
- [Plutus Flow Learning Guide](https://docs.signalpilot.io/plutus-flow-v10/learning.html): OBV divergence and accumulation/distribution patterns
- [Harmonic Oscillator v1.0](https://docs.signalpilot.io/harmonic-oscillator-v10/): 7-component voting momentum consensus — TRENDING/BIAS/RANGING regime detection
- [Harmonic Oscillator Learning Guide](https://docs.signalpilot.io/harmonic-oscillator-v10/learning.html): 7-oscillator voting consensus and divergence strategies
- [Volume Oracle v1.0](https://docs.signalpilot.io/volume-oracle-v10/): 5-system volume intelligence — Regime Detection, Signal Generation, Risk Management, HTF Confirmation, Strategy Modes
- [Volume Oracle Learning Guide](https://docs.signalpilot.io/volume-oracle-v10/learning.html): Volume flow analysis and regime detection strategies
- [Suite Overview](https://docs.signalpilot.io/suite-index/): Side-by-side overview and comparison of all 7 indicators

## How-To Guides

- [Setting Up Alerts](https://docs.signalpilot.io/how-to-alerts/): Configure TradingView alerts with Once Per Bar Close confirmation — avoid false signals
- [Using Webhooks](https://docs.signalpilot.io/how-to-webhooks/): Send alerts to Discord, Telegram, and 3commas via TradingView webhooks
- [Using the Screener](https://docs.signalpilot.io/how-to-screener/): Multi-symbol monitoring with Augury Grid — scan 7 symbols across 3 timeframes
